CHAPTER 15 · ITEM 13 / 14

Long-run equilibrium and changes

Demand changes across horizons需求變化的短長期

YOUR CHECKBOX · 原始清單項目

Explain how a demand change affects price and profits in the short run, then entry or exit and the long-run outcome. Understand why long-run industry supply can be horizontal under identical constant-cost conditions and upward sloping if input costs rise or firms differ.

01 · UNDERSTAND / 概念解釋

需求增加先令短期價、每家產量及利潤升；長期進入擴大供給。相同固定成本行業長期價回最低 ATC，總量及企業數增加；投入稀缺或成本不同可令長期供給向上。

A demand increase raises price and operating output in the short run with a fixed number of firms. Profits then attract entry. With identical constant-cost firms, long-run price returns to minimum ATC while market quantity and firm count rise. Limited inputs or differing firm costs can make LR supply upward sloping.

02 · WORKED EXAMPLE / 一個示範

See it in action.

Example 例：Long-run price is 10 and firm q=10. Demand expansion raises total long-run Q from 100 to 140, increasing firm count from 10 to 14.
